headline: Nigerian Exchange Market Capitalization Hits Record N164.97 Trillion
summary: The Nigerian Exchange Limited (NGX) reached an all-time high as total market capitalization for listed equities surged to N164.97 trillion on October 29, 2026.
why: The NGX is the primary stock exchange in Nigeria, and its performance reflects investor confidence in the country's largest publicly traded companies.
why_moved: The record-breaking surge in market capitalization indicates strong buying pressure and increased valuation of listed Nigerian equities.
